page_title: FIO 5-1 FRO | Fiorentina v Frosinone 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Ermano Feliciani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is yellow-carded.
90+1' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
85' 5 - 1 Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) heads the ball towards the goal from close range, and his effort makes it home! What a goal!
85' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
83' A substitution has been made. Lucas Beltran is replaced by Antonin Barak (Fiorentina).

83' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.

81' What a chance that is! Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
81' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
80' Reinier (Frosinone) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
80' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
78' Substitution. Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) replaces Francesco Gelli.
75' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Ermano Feliciani signals.
73' Substitution. Alfred Duncan walks off the pitch and Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
73' Here is a change. Lucas Martinez Quarta is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andrea Belotti as he is replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina).
73' Pietro Terracciano pulls off a fine save! Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
71' A pass from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Stefano Turati and the move breaks down.
69' Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Ermano Feliciani pulls out a yellow card.

66' 4 - 1 Goal! Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) takes the resulting free-kick from the edge of the box, but the ball takes a deflection off a defender and goes past the helpless Pietro Terracciano and into the net. 4:1.
66' A player from Fiorentina pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Frosinone earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
65' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Reinier (Frosinone) replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
64' It's time for a substitution. Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) comes on in place of Abdou Harroui.
64' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
61' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) replaces Nicolas Gonzalez.
58' Emanuele Valeri tees up Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just wide of the right post.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.
56' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
53' 4 - 0 Goal! Alfred Duncan gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 4:0.
51' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Ermano Feliciani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
50' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) picked up a yellow card from referee.
48' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) heads on.
48' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
48' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Frosinone can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Demba Seck (Frosinone) comes off for Pol Lirola.
46' The game is over for Ilario Monterisi. Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) comes on for the second half.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' 3 - 0 Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Cristiano Biraghi. His header slid off the underside of the crossbar and into the roof of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance. It's 3:0.
43' The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
43' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
42' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
42' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
41' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
40' What a big chance! Matias Soule (Frosinone) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
39' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.

37' This would have been a magnificent goal from Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.

36' A loose ball is pounced on by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Pietro Terracciano is alert and makes a comfortable save.
35' Frosinone get a corner.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Frosinone, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
28' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
25' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort that ends well wide of the right post.
22' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Michael Kayode (Fiorentina).
21' Matias Soule (Frosinone) swings in a cross from the corner, but Pietro Terracciano reads it well and gathers the ball.
21' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Now Frosinone have a corner.
19' 2 - 0 Goal! Alfred Duncan plays it to Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Stefano Turati. 2:0.
18' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

16' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Jonathan Ikone plays the ball to the feet of Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 1:0.
15' Demba Seck (Frosinone) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
13' The ball falls kindly for Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar.
13' CHANCE! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
12' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
11' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
10' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
8' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
4' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
3' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) dribbles into the box, but Pietro Terracciano is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
2' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Ermano Feliciani will referee today's match.
